slogan: Where Atomic Settlement Meets Liquidity Efficiency

problem.title: Why do we need NettedX?
problem.lead: Traditional settlement is not broken because value is missing. It is expensive because gross obligations keep accumulating, and each movement of value demands fresh liquidity.
problem.conclusion: The problem isn't the amount of value being moved. It's how much liquidity must be committed to move it.

aggregate.title: {highlight} · Transaction Aggregation
aggregate.text: Transactions accumulate within a fixed window of N blocks. During the window, no assets move at all; the contract only records obligations.

net.title: {highlight} · Netting
net.text: Once the window closes, the smart contract will calculate the net amount for each participant. DvP is still guaranteed by atomicity, rather than by a trusted intermediary; participants retain control of their assets throughout the process.

settle.title: {highlight} · Settlement
settle.text: Settlement is performed within the same transaction for all transfers; either all are completed or none occur. We restored the netting, but did not reintroduce a trusted third party.

beforeAfter.desc: NettedX turns gross obligations into net settlement.
beforeAfter.footer: Based on an assumption of 1000 transactions, the efficiency of NettedX is calculated.

howWorks.title: How It Works
howWorks.desc: With the help of cutting-edge technologies, we continue to innovate.

card1.title: Smart Contract
card1.desc: We use smart contracts to record transaction obligations, verify netting results, and execute atomic asset transfers, ensuring that settlement either completes entirely or reverts as a whole.

card2.title: Atomic Settlement
card2.desc: All netted asset transfers are executed within a single transaction, providing atomicity across participants and eliminating the risk of partial settlement.

card3.title: On-chain Netting Engine
card3.desc: Transactions are aggregated within fixed netting windows, allowing NettedX to calculate each participant’s net position and compress thousands of bilateral obligations into fewer settlement obligations.

card4.title: Liquidity Optimization
card4.desc: By offsetting mutual payment obligations between participants, NettedX reduces the liquidity required to settle the same transaction volume, enabling capital to support more activity.

card5.title: Netting Windows
card5.desc: Transactions are accumulated within a defined block-based window before settlement. During the window, no assets are moved—the protocol only records settlement obligations.

card6.title: Verifiable Settlement
card6.desc: Netting results can be verified on-chain, making settlement amounts transparent and auditable while reducing reliance on centralized clearing infrastructure.

card7.desc: NettedX calculates net positions independently across different assets and settles them through a unified process, improving capital efficiency across multi-token environments.
card7.title: Multi-Asset Netting

card8.title: Composable Architecture
card8.desc: NettedX provides modular netting and settlement infrastructure that can integrate with existing Web3 applications, protocols, and asset systems.

title.text: Ready to Move More With Less?
